The wrapper reads connection.info.server_version under temporary_connection, and returns a major/minor tuple using divmod with 10000. Scope is the PostgreSQL version value and its conversion, not base connection lifecycle, validation thresholds or third-party overrides. The base temporary-connection implementation is therefore optional context, not a required file for this question. Unknown receiver dispatch remains unconfirmed. The PostGIS SQL version() sanity-check return is discarded; it does not supply the specified connection.info.server_version value or divmod conversion. Scope and source anchors are recorded in benchmarks/mcp/django-postgresql-version-noise-audit.md. This refinement followed inspection of returned files, so it is not blinded validation; no product rule was tuned in the audit batch. Original reports remain unchanged; both comparison versions are re-scored under the revised judgments. A 2026-10-02 pinned-source and CPython AST expansion additionally judges debug diagnostics, the MySQL version provider, PostgreSQL capability thresholds and SQLite capability thresholds irrelevant to this unchanged scope. These four judgments were fixed from manual pinned-source reading before the joint file-coverage trial; a separate CPython AST audit subsequently confirmed the source spans and expressions. Observed baseline and failed comment-weighting trial files motivated inspection, so this remains development evidence. The expansion and re-scoring are documented in the same noise audit.
